93	        self,

106	        old_context_len = original_max_position_embeddings  # `8192` in the original implementation

109	        high_freq_wavelen = old_context_len / high_freq_factor

113	        # wavelen > low_freq_wavelen: divide by factor

46	    def _relative_position_bucket(
47	        self, relative_position, bidirectional=True, num_buckets=32, max_distance=128
48	    ):
49	        """
50	        Adapted from HuggingFace T5 Model:
51	        https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/329f5dbf97a5cb2473914c88c05aa3dcb242e19a/
52	        src/transformers/models/t5/modeling_t5.py#L397
53	
54	        Translate relative position to a bucket number for relative attention.
55	        The relative position is defined as memory_position - query_position, i.e. the
56	        distance in tokens from the attending position to the attended-to position.
57	        If bidirectional=False, then positive relative positions are invalid. We use
58	        smaller buckets for small absolute relative_position and larger buckets for
59	        larger absolute relative_positions. All relative positions >=max_distance map
60	        to the same bucket. All relative positions <=-max_distance map to the same bucket.
61	        This should allow for more graceful generalization to longer sequences than the
62	        model has been trained on.
63	
64	        Args:
65	            relative_position: an int32 Tensor
66	            bidirectional: a boolean - whether the attention is bidirectional
67	            num_buckets: an integer
68	            max_distance: an integer
69	        Returns:
70	            a Tensor with the same shape as relative_position,
71	            containing int32 values in the range [0, num_buckets)
72	        """
73	        relative_buckets = 0
74	        if bidirectional:
75	            num_buckets //= 2
76	            relative_buckets += (relative_position > 0).to(torch.long) * num_buckets
77	            relative_position = torch.abs(relative_position)
78	        else:
79	            relative_position = -torch.min(relative_position, torch.zeros_like(relative_position))
80	        # now relative_position is in the range [0, inf)
81	
82	        # half of the buckets are for exact increments in positions
83	        max_exact = num_buckets // 2
84	        is_small = relative_position < max_exact
85	
86	        # The other half of the buckets are for logarithmically bigger
87	        # bins in positions up to max_distance
88	        relative_position_if_large = max_exact + (

90	            / math.log(max_distance / max_exact)

92	        ).to(torch.long)
93	        relative_position_if_large = torch.min(
94	            relative_position_if_large, torch.full_like(relative_position_if_large, num_buckets - 1)
95	        )
